title: EXCEPTION
description: Automation stopped and asked. A human is engaged because a decision exceeded an envelope, never because the system could not move its own work forward.

class.description: Classify every exception. Only the first is meant to recur; the rest are backlog items, and an unclassified exception queue is a queue that never shortens.

options.description: At least two. One option is a notification wearing a decision's clothes.

uncertainty.description: What would change the recommendation. Stated honestly, this is the most useful line in the packet.

deadline.description: When not deciding becomes a decision.

stepKey.description: The workflow step this exception blocks, if any - lets resolution act on the step it blocked instead of only recording that a decision happened.
